note: The graph-sketch checker's question list (SPEC-SKETCH-CHECK.md, 5 Oct 2026). School prelim / promo / mid-year H2 questions from the bank whose function is fully numeric, so every feature can be computed. Never a national (GCE) row. `expr` is the function-graph grammar the bot computes from; `shown` is LaTeX for the page; `asks` = the feature groups the question names (shape is always checked); `exact` = the question asks for exact values.
